input.quote: Such inspections may be made no more than once each calendar year, at reasonable times and upon reasonable notice. Commerce One shall bear all costs and expenses of such inspection.
input.rationale: Section 4.4 is the only audit right binding Corio (our party). It already meets much of our position: once per calendar year, independent CPA reasonably acceptable to us, Commerce One bears costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no system access is granted. It deviates by leaving notice and timing as merely "reasonable" rather than a fixed 30 days' prior written notice during business hours, and by not requiring the auditor to be bound by confidentiality (the § 10 NDA binds only the parties, not their accountants). The redline adds those three items and confirms no access to our systems, without disturbing the agreed frequency or cost allocation.

proposal.summary: Specify 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, and auditor confidentiality undertaking in the § 4.4 audit right
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have tightened the audit mechanics to at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice, our normal business hours, and an auditor who has signed a confidentiality undertaking, consistent with our position that audits be rare, notified and confidential; the existing annual cap and Commerce One cost allocation are unchanged. We can accept fifteen (15) days' notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: an independent certified public accountant reasonably acceptable to Corio for the purpose of verifying the amounts payable to Commerce One under this Agreement. Such inspections may be made no more than once each calendar year, at reasonable times and upon reasonable notice.
ops.newText: an independent certified public accountant reasonably acceptable to Corio (and who has executed a written confidentiality agreement with Corio) for the purpose of verifying the amounts payable to Commerce One under this Agreement. Such inspections may be made no more than once each calendar year, during Corio's normal business hours and upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice, and shall not include any access to Corio's systems or networks.
